title: What the Operator Asks For: A Velocity Command, Clipped to What the Robot Can Do and Eased Toward by a Bounded Acceleration

artifact.note: the command a quadruped is given, a forward speed, a sideways speed and a turn rate: the limits on it (an ellipse in the forward and sideways speeds, since a leg cannot step as far sideways as forward, and a cap on the turn rate), the bounded acceleration with which the command actually used is eased toward the one asked for (so that a jump in the stick is a ramp), the fastest speed the legs allow (the step length the leg's reach allows over the stance time the swing allows), and the step length and period a speed needs
